an3.131:1.1: “Mendicants, three things are conveyed under cover, not in the open.
an3.131:1.3: Ladies are conveyed for marriage with a veil, not unveiled.
an3.131:1.4: Hymns of the brahmins are conveyed under cover, not openly.
an3.131:1.5: Wrong view is conveyed under cover, not in the open.
an3.131:1.6: These three things are conveyed under cover, not in the open.
an3.131:2.1: Three things dazzle in the open, not under cover.
an3.131:2.3: The moon dazzles in the open, not under cover.
an3.131:2.4: The sun dazzles in the open, not under cover.
an3.131:2.5: The teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One dazzle in the open, not under cover.
an3.131:2.6: These three things dazzle in the open, not under cover.”
